concept: DR strategies: warm standby (RTO minutes, RPO seconds)
tests: Choosing a DR strategy for an RTO of minutes and RPO of seconds, cheaper than a full duplicate environment.
expected: Warm standby — a scaled-down but running copy of the environment that scales up quickly in a disaster. Triggers: "RTO of a few minutes", "RPO of seconds", "lower cost than full duplicate".
why_not: Backup and restore and pilot light — slower recovery; multi-site active-active — most expensive, full capacity all the time.
